integrity: Uniform proof through explicit relative simplicial Morse matching, induction and integral Alexander duality; finite exact checks are corroborative and independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite connected simple graphs with at least six vertices and girth at least six; original total cut complex classified only at integral homology level, not by homotopy type.
title: Cycle-rank homology of total three-cut complexes of high-girth graphs
